summary.text: Melvin Latham is the Republican candidate for Oklahoma House of Representatives District 99 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Herschel Brown (D).
Ballotpedia lists him as retired, with a bachelor's degree from Langston University in 1979.

paragraphs.text: Melvin Latham earned a high school diploma from East Side High School and a bachelor's degree from Langston University in 1979.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Latham said his journey began in Boyle, Mississippi, and brought him to Oklahoma, where he began studies at Langston University in the fall of 1973.
He said he was a member of the university band, Kappa Kappa Psi and Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc.

He said he began working with the Federal Aviation Administration in January 1977 through the university's cooperative education program and graduated in 1979 with degrees in electronics technology and industrial technology.
Latham said he is retired and would be fully available to serve constituents.
